LESSON: TRANSPORT IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa
Topic 3.4: Transport in Eastern Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Transport in Eastern Africa, part of Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why do we need transport networks in our country?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Transport in Eastern Africa in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Transport in Eastern Africa in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Transport in Eastern Africa together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: learners collaborate with others as they identify, in groups, transport networks in Eastern Africa using digital devices.

● Responsibility: learners proactively solve problems as they establish challenges facing transport networks in Eastern Africa using digital

devices and share in class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Environmental Education: learners establish challenges facing transport networks in Eastern Africa using digital devices and share in class.

● Safety and Security: learners establish challenges facing transport networks in Eastern Africa using digital devices and share in class.

Link to other Learning Areas:

• Pre-technical studies: learners locate the main transport networks in Eastern Africa.

• Agriculture and nutrition: learners discuss challenges facing transport networks in Eastern Africa.
